definition: Edge cell identifier 'ix_iy' of a 100 m x 100 m UTM 15N (EPSG:32615) grid cell crossed by SCAT-surveyed shoreline
Cell column index = floor(easting / 100 m), EPSG:32615
Cell row index = floor(northing / 100 m), EPSG:32615
Most frequent NOAA Environmental Sensitivity Index shoreline code among SCAT survey records crossing the cell (10A = salt marsh)
SCAT segment with most survey records in the cell
Numeric oiling rank: 0 NOO, 1 Very Light, 2 Light, 3 Moderate, 4 Heavy (TB variants folded into base class)
Worst SCAT maximum-oiling category among zones crossing the cell; NOO = surveyed, no oil observed
Earliest SCAT survey date recording any oil in the cell
missing_rule: empty for cells never recorded as oiled

definition: 2 km block 'bx_by' containing the cell; used for block intercepts and clustered standard errors
Hold-out basin from fixed geographic lines (D8)
Open-water share within 1 km of the cell centre, 2010 NAIP land/water mosaic at 16 m
NAIP flight year
Share of the cell's 2 m pixels classified as vegetated land in that NAIP year (2010: NDVI and NIR Otsu rule; later years: per-tile classifier trained on 2010 interior pixels)
missing_rule: NaN where no usable tile covers the cell

definition: Share of the cell's 2 m pixels with a usable classification
Most common NAIP flight date among the cell's valid pixels
Land share of the 1 km block containing the cell, same year; used by the block failure filter
Open-water share within 250 m of the cell centre, 2010 NAIP mosaic at 16 m
Mean open-water distance from the cell to the first land pixel along 16 compass directions, capped at 10 km, 2010 NAIP mosaic at 16 m
Landsat epoch: A 1998-2000 (Landsat 5), B 2007-2009 (Landsat 5), C 2014-2016 (Landsat 8); April-October scenes
Median number of clear scenes behind the cell's 30 m pixels in that epoch
Median SWIR1 surface reflectance of clear pixels more than 60 m inside 2010 land (marsh calibration value)
missing_rule: empty if too few interior pixels

definition: Median SWIR1 surface reflectance of clear pixels more than 60 m inside 2010 water
missing_rule: empty if too few interior pixels

definition: Scene passed the marsh/water contrast check (marsh - water >= 0.02, ASSUMED) and was used
Held-out accuracy of the per-tile land/water classifier on 2010 interior pixels
missing_rule: empty for 2010 tiles and untrainable tiles

definition: Tile-year kept: 2010, or classifier trained and land share within 0.10 of 2010 (ASSUMED)
CRMS site class: oiled (Light or worse within 1 km), unoiled (surveyed shoreline within 1 km and no oil within 5 km), excluded
Distance from the CRMS site to the nearest SCAT-surveyed shoreline (proxy for distance to marsh edge)
Group mean as published in Zengel et al. 2015 S1 Table (units given in the metric name)
missing_rule: empty where the table says ND

definition: Standard error of the group mean, as published
Plots per group, as published
Marsh-edge erosion from aerial-photo shorelines (DSAS), plot mean over transects; positive = erosion, negative = accretion
Treatment group as labelled by the authors
Period over which the erosion rate is calculated
API gravity as reported in the NOAA ADIOS record (141.5/SG - 131.5); the minimum, -37.2, is a fuel additive (anti-knock compound, 1,500 kg/m3), not a spill oil
Pour point
Kinematic viscosity at viscosity_ref_c
Observed NAIP edge-loss rate 2010-2015 = (land 2010 - land 2015) x 100 m / years between flights; NAIP reads about 1.2 m/yr below field measurements (P3)
Primary P2 model prediction for the held-out basin (exposure + pre-spill trend + oiling class, linear)

Landsat land share of the cell: per-scene SWIR1 unmixing between that scene's interior water and marsh values, per-pixel median over the epoch's scenes, averaged over the cell; reads about 0.1 below NAIP (mixed pixels)
missing_rule: NaN where pixels have < 5 clear scenes

definition: Share of the cell's area with a valid Landsat epoch median

Marsh soil shear strength per plot (root-zone strength; sampling date and depth to be checked in the paper); group labels differ from the DSAS sheets (MAN. TREATMENT, MECH. TREATMENT, REFERENCE, UNTREATED)
